visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot shows a hand in a black nitrile glove using a small knife to slice open a soft, yellow omelet resting on top of a hamburger steak and rice; a paw print is branded on the egg surface. (2) A quick montage follows, showing the restaurant's exterior with 'Ikura' signage, a man in a striped shirt eating enthusiastically, and a chef in a black cap and apron waving at the camera. (3) The main character, wearing a blue and white striped shirt, peers from behind a metallic partition and then walks into a brightly lit restaurant with open kitchen counters and warm wooden tables. (4) The camera focuses on a menu held in hands, with fingers pointing to different sets and sauce options illustrated with photos of omelet rice. (5) The chef in black gloves is seen pouring various thick sauces—dark brown demi-glace and creamy orange mentaiko sauce—over perfectly round hamburger patties on ceramic plates. (6) In the kitchen, the chef prepares the meat, shaping the raw ground beef into patties, dusting them with white flour, and placing them on a hot flat-top grill where they sizzle. (7) The chef uses a spatula to scramble eggs on the grill for exactly 28 seconds before folding them into a delicate oval and placing them onto the rice; he then applies a hot iron to brand the paw print. (8) The main character sits at a counter, struggling to cut the slippery omelet with a knife, laughing as the egg slides, before successfully taking a large spoonful. (9) He is shown tasting three different versions, reacting with wide eyes and nodding; a woman with long dark hair in a white top joins him to taste the black curry version. (10) The scene shifts to show the 'Ikura' brand sign again, followed by the man waving his hands excitedly in front of the store. (11) Close-up shots display promotional merchandise including circular keychains with the brand logo and stainless steel spoons with paw-print engravings. (12) Finally, the man sits back at the table, gesturing towards his meal and speaking directly to the camera with high energy.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional review and guide for the new Taipei branch of a popular Fukuoka omelet rice restaurant, 'Ikura'. It uses energetic hosting and close-up 'food porn' visuals to emphasize the quality and variety of the dishes.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed mention of opening dates, location, promotional gifts (keychains/spoons), and direct naming of the restaurant.
